headline: Approved 2028 Greece world language trip and took first reading of policy changes on athletics, facilities fees, and allergies.
summary: Members approved their consent agenda of staff appointments and a resignation. They also approved the minutes of the October 14 meeting. Votes were taken on first readings of several policy changes, covering athletics, facilities, and records retention.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the October 14, 2026 meeting, unanimously.
Approved the consent agenda, including staff appointments and a resignation, unanimously.
Approved the overnight World Language trip to Greece over April Vacation 2028, unanimously.
Unanimously approved first reading of the Travel Expense Reimbursement policy (DKC).
Unanimously approved first reading of the School Facilities Fee Schedule policy (KF-R).
Unanimously approved first reading of the policy on students with diagnosed allergies and sensitivities (JLCEA).
Unanimously approved first reading of revisions to the athletics and extracurricular rules for students (JJIC-R).
Unanimously approved first reading of revisions to the community use of school facilities policy (KF).
Unanimously approved first reading of revisions to the School Committee officers policy (BDB).
Unanimously approved first reading of revisions to the executive sessions policy (BEC).
Unanimously approved first reading of revisions to the executive session law policy (BEC-R).
Unanimously approved first reading of revisions to the School Committee member compensation and expenses policy (BID).
Unanimously approved first reading of the 2025 comprehensive health and safety and emergency management plan (EBCA).
Unanimously approved first reading of revisions to the school records retention policy (EHB).
